descriptionChirho: Causal preposition (from noun galal with beth prefix) meaning 'because of, on account of, for the sake of.' All 10 occurrences express the same causal-reason relationship, whether with a following noun complement (eng: because-of, spa: por-causa-de, a-causa-de, hin: कारण-से, के-कारण, arb: بِسَبَبِ, kor: 때문에, swa: kwa-sababu-ya) or with pronominal suffixes (eng: because-of-you, on-account-of-you, spa: por-causa-tuya, hin: तुम्हारे-कारण, arb: بِ-سَبَبِكُمْ, kor: 때문에-너희, swa: kwa-sababu-yako).
